entry.name: EgoTac-SC
entry.title: EgoTac: In-the-wild Tactile Prediction from Egocentric Vision
entry.summary: Bimanual in-house motion-tactile gloves (60 finger + 72 palm force channels per hand, 11 nine-axis IMUs) with HTC VIVE wrist trackers and a head-mounted ZED 2i, in 857 clips (~36 h, 3.9M frames at 30 Hz) of 70+ household tasks in 24 environments; released with 224x224 egocentric RGB, glove forces, hand and wrist poses and MANO-mapped force and contact.
entry.hand: AetherGlove motion-tactile gloves on both hands (EgoTac paper: 'in-house'; release folder 'aether_v1')

sensor.note: Per hand: <side>_finger_tactile (T, 5, 12) + <side>_palm_tactile (T, 72) float64, force per channel (paper: calibrated force in N, contact threshold 0.05 N); 0.0-4.4 in the clips checked, 77-78% of values exactly 0. Raw streams were resampled to the 30 Hz camera timeline by linear interpolation. Five bend-related channels per glove and the IMU signals are not released. Also mano_tactile_<side> (T, 778) float32 force mapped onto MANO vertices and mano_contact_<side> (T, 778) uint8 (mapped force > 0.05 N).
sensor.maker: Aether Embodied Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. (named in FTP-1's acknowledgments); the EgoTac paper calls the glove in-house
sensor.model: AetherGlove (motion-tactile glove; 'aether' / 'ether' in the release names)

scale.text: 857 clips, 3,896,609 frames @30 Hz (~36.1 h), 70+ tasks (e.g. folding clothes, wiping tables, opening doors) in 24 environments; clips 5-632 s (median 137 s), recorded 2025-11-20 to 2025-12-30

entry.access: Hugging Face wkzhang/EgoTac-SC, ungated: 857 Zarr clips (458 GB) packed whole into 45 stored ZIP shards of ~10 GB with a manifest.json that maps clips to shards; linked from the project page and code README. A second repo, wkzhang/EgoTac-SC-OXT (created 2026-10-12), holds only a README.
caveats: Egocentric video is released only as 224x224 resized and cropped frames; the 1080p ZED 2i video, depth and point clouds, and the raw HDF5/SVO recordings are not released.
No task, environment or participant label per clip: each Zarr holds only data arrays and meta/episode_ends; clip names are millisecond timestamps.

Tactile units are not stated in the release; the paper evaluates EgoTac-SC force in newtons (error < 0.06 N, contact threshold 0.05 N). Bend channels and the 11 IMUs per glove are not released; hand pose is a processed 20-joint 6-D array.
MANO force and contact fields are interpolated from the 132 glove channels through predefined patches, not measured per vertex.
Glove-recoloured RGB and glove masks exist only in shards 1-16; shards 17-45 carry the plain RGB only.
Every clip sits inside a ~10 GB stored ZIP; one clip needs HTTP range reads of the central directory (Zip64) and its entries, or the whole shard.
Participants wear black gloves, so the RGB shows gloved hands (the paper discusses this visual-domain gap).

tracking.note: <side>_hand_pose_ether_dataset (T, 20, 6): 20 hand joint poses, position (m by range) + 3 rotation values
head pose; source device not stated

other: MANO-vertex force and binary contact per hand (778 vertices)

sources: https://huggingface.co/datasets/wkzhang/EgoTac-SC (README.md, aether_v1/manifest.json, file listing, commit history; Zip64 central directories of all 45 shards; timestamps/.zarray of all 857 clips)
https://huggingface.co/datasets/wkzhang/EgoTac-SC aether_v1-part-0001.zip entries of clip 1763647052611.zarr (all arrays except RGB and masks; .zarray metadata of all arrays)
https://huggingface.co/datasets/wkzhang/EgoTac-SC tactile arrays and one RGB chunk of 8 clips from 8 recording days (parts 0001, 0002, 0003, 0005, 0014, 0023, 0032, 0041)
https://arxiv.org/html/2606.13102 (FTP-1: data-source table and acknowledgments naming AetherGlove and Aether Embodied Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.)
unconfirmed: hours=36.1 and frames=3,896,609: sum of the timestamps array lengths of all 857 clips (from each clip's .zarray) at 30 Hz; matches the paper's 3.9M frames. Clip lengths 152-18,960 frames (5.1-632 s).

calibrated=true and unit N rest on the paper (calibrated force prediction on EgoTac-SC, force MAE in N, contact = mapped force > 0.05 N); the dataset card and processing docs do not state units. Values are floats, 0 at rest on 77-78% of entries, peaks 0.4-4.4 in 9 clips checked.

tasks=70 is the paper's 'more than 70'; scenes=24 is the paper's '24 diverse environments'. Neither is labelled per clip. The clips span 24 recording days (2025-11-20 to 2025-12-30, from the millisecond clip names); frames checked show bedrooms, a kitchen, a living room and a dining table, hence scene_type 'home' in addition to the paper's 'kitchens, offices'.
Paper wording differs: '264 force sensors' (2 x 132) in Sec. 3.3, 'more than 120 sensing points' per glove in App. B. The release has 132 per hand.
coverage 'tip': each finger has one 12-channel block; where on the finger it sits is not stated.
The 5 x 12 finger + 72 palm channel counts match the TouchTronix v2 conductive-fabric glove SDK (4x3 per finger, 72 populated palm cells); the paper calls the glove in-house and names no vendor.
Hand pose layout (20 joints x [x, y, z, 3 rotation values]) is read from the data (positions up to 0.94 m, rotations within +-pi); the rotation convention is not documented.
head_tracker_pose source is not stated (the paper lists VIVE trackers only for the wrists).

Glove maker: FTP-1 (arXiv 2606.13102; its authors include EgoTac authors Wenkang Zhang, Chengbo Yuan, Zicheng Zhang and Yang Gao) thanks 'Aether Embodied Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. for the EgoTac egocentric human dataset and AetherGlove'; the EgoTac paper says 'in-house motion-tactile glove' and the code README says 'EgoTac-SC and Aether are the same dataset'.

used_by.name: FTP-1 (arXiv 2606.13102)
used_by.note: trains its tactile policy partly on EgoTac human data ('EgoTac-Open', 'EgoTac-Kitchen', 'EgoTac-Hotel', AetherGlove arrays, 17.5% of the mixture); whether these are subsets of the EgoTac-SC release is not stated

download.format: aether_v1/aether_v1-part-0001..0045.zip (stored ZIP64, ~10 GB each) holding whole <ms_timestamp>.zarr groups (Zarr v2, Blosc/Zstd): data/{ego_cam_rgb, ego_cam_rgb_recolored*, glove_mask*, ego_cam_real_timestamp, timestamps, head_tracker_pose, left/right_wrist_pose, left/right_hand_pose_ether_dataset, left/right_finger_tactile, left/right_palm_tactile, mano_tactile_left/right, mano_contact_left/right}, meta/episode_ends; aether_v1/manifest.json maps clips to shards with SHA-256 (* shards 1-16 only)
download.per_episode: clip 1763647052611 (141.8 s): RGB ~455 MB + recoloured RGB ~432 MB + mask 1.8 MB + all other arrays ~18 MB
download.partial_fetch: HTTP range requests on the shard resolve URL (redirects to a CDN): read the Zip64 end record and central directory (~0.4 MB per shard), then fetch single Zarr chunk entries by local-header offset (stored, no recompression). Tactile + pose arrays of one clip are ~3-20 MB; RGB chunks are ~7 MB per 64-67 frames.

sample.fetch_estimate: ~1.7 GB: per 60 s window ~27 RGB chunks x ~7 MB (~190 MB) plus tactile, pose and MANO arrays (~10-20 MB per clip, whole-clip chunks), via range reads from 8 shards. Re-hosted media: 224x224 frames encoded to H.264, ~1-2 MB per 60 s. Episode JSON: 60 s x 30 Hz x 264 channels = 475k numbers; round to 2 decimals (or 0.01 N integers) to stay under 2 MB; skip the 778-vertex MANO fields or show one hand per frame.
sample.rules_applied: Tasks: 70+ unlabelled tasks; 8 clips chosen from 8 different recording days across 8 shards, spanning bedroom, kitchen, dining and living-room scenes and different actions (judged from one middle RGB frame each, since no task labels exist). Episodes: one per chosen task, 8 in total. Each was screened on its full tactile arrays: all 5 finger blocks and the palm present on both hands, no NaN, reading above 0.05 for >= 1 s (above zero for most of the clip). Length: one 60.1 s clip cut to [0, 60]; the others to a 60 s window centred on the checked middle frame. Budget: ~1.7 GB of 20 GB.
deviations: Task names are our description of one middle frame per clip; the release has no task labels.
